name: Look-alikes from a reference
markdown:
# Look-alikes from a reference

> From the author's earlier studio, cleaned for publication: private paths, ports and some lines were removed, so a step may read short and a screen it names may not exist here. Status in this studio: Tested on the author's old stack.


## Purpose / when to use it
Redux appends 729 SigLIP image tokens from a reference to a Flux.1 prompt. Tested verdict: **it copies the reference's
content, it does not transfer style**. At attn_bias 0.05 it does nothing; at 0.10 the reference subject already leaks in
5/6 cases; at 0.15+ the reference takes over 6/6. That is why the studio rows are labelled "Reference look-alike
(Redux: copies its content)" and stay off. For style, use Klein (`image-klein-style-transfer.md`).

What it would be good for once enabled: `redux:variation` (no prompt, full strength) = variations of a reference image.

## Step-by-step in the studio UI
Today the three `redux:*` rows show in the Image drop-down as "(unavailable)" with the reason "Flux.1 Redux is off until
its night test passes". Nothing can be generated. If the author flips the flag:
1. Image tab → `Flux.1 · Variations of an image (Redux, ComfyUI)` (or the look-alike / masked rows).
2. Drop the reference into `image` (masked row: also `mask_image`, white = the part to use).
3. Chips: strength (look-alike rows only: medium 0.6 default, light 0.3, full 1.0), aspect (`match` = nearest studio
   ratio to the reference), takes 1-4.
4. Prompt: none for variation (never enhanced); a Flux.1 prose prompt for the look-alike rows.

`df:flux_redux · Variations of an image` (dfserve) is gone: dfserve was retired 2026-10-12 and the entry is hidden.

## Optimal settings
| Setting | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Base | `flux/flux_abliterated_transformer.safetensors`, `weight_dtype default` (bf16) | `MODEL` in `image_redux_tools.py`; template `flux1_t2i.api.json`; (earlier commit) |
| Steps / guidance / sampler | 28 / FluxGuidance 3.5 / euler simple | `MODEL`; capability run flux1_abliterated main arm |
| Redux node | core StyleModelApply, `attn_bias`, SigLIP-384 center crop | `STRENGTH_TYPE`, `add_redux` |
| Strength chips | light 0.3 / medium 0.6 / full 1.0 | `STRENGTHS`. Measured: no usable style window at any value (0.05-0.30) |
| Variation | full 1.0, no prompt | `runners._run_redux` |
| Mask | crops the reference to the white box + 10 % before encoding (no token masking) | `MASK_MARGIN` |
| Default seed | 2201 | `REDUX_SEED` |
| ReduxAdvanced (token downsampling 1-5) | installed on the  a local port sidecar only; 80/80 rows rendered 2026-10-11 (median 7.3 s), **not scored yet** | FLUX_REDUX_STYLE.md "ReduxAdvanced test"; `results_late_reduxadv.jsonl` |

## Prompting rules
- Flux.1 prose; the reference dominates regardless. Rules page of the base:
  `a local folder`.
- Do not use Redux to "add a style": pick a reference whose content you actually want repeated.

## Guards and gates

## Time and VRAM
- bf16 path: 9.7-10 s warm, **35.4 GiB** measured port peak (`images.md` §8). The code still says `PEAK_GIB = 28.0`
  (the old fp8 estimate; fp8 night test measured 20.4 GiB). If the flag is flipped, set the peak to the bf16 value
  first, or the preflight under-reserves by ~7 GiB.
- dfserve Redux: 22.7 GiB bf16 + offload (diffusion_fast NOTES.md); float8 base renders all-black.

## Known pitfalls / failure modes
- **`df:flux_redux` hazard:** its loader pulls the SigLIP prior from `black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-Redux-dev`, which is
  **not in** `a local folder` (only a stale `.locks` entry, checked 2026-10-11), and the loader sets
  `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0`. A request would start an in-worker download of a gated repo: the same wedge pattern that got
  `qwen_image` hidden (`variants.DF_HIDDEN`). Don't pick it; FLUX_REDUX_STYLE.md recommends hiding it.
- Low strengths are a cliff, not a dial (0.05 none, 0.10 content leak).
- The film look never transfers without the noodle bowl coming along (`images.md` §8).

## Evidence
- Sheets `a local folder`; night test `.../results.json`, `sheet.png`.
- Rows `a local folder` (44/44);
  `a local folder` (80/80, unscored).
- `a local folder` (dfserve Redux, float8 → black).
- Commits (earlier commit), (earlier commit), (earlier commit).
